dsh-caption-bar README · dsh-caption-bar：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Reclaim a full row of vertical space in DeepSeek Harness.** Instead of spending a separate row on conversation navigation and session utilities, this desktop layout plugin seats the view tabs in the Windows caption row and compresses the remaining utilities into a 42px right rail. More of the window is left for the conversation—especially valuable on laptops and other short displays.

It:
dsh-caption-bar README · dsh-caption-bar：Verified with Codex UI 1.1.49 and DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.3+.

dsh-caption-bar README · Final layout：| Area | Contents |
|---|---|
| Caption row | application menu → view tabs / more-views → centred session title → fullscreen → native window buttons |
| Right rail | agent preset, subagent status/count/menu, background-job status/count/menu, file-manager split control, utilities menu, right-sidebar control |
| Conversation | gives up exactly `--dsh-capbar-rail` on the right, so the rail never covers messages |

dsh-caption-bar README · Final layout：The tab row uses the preload menu's own dimensions and tokens: 28px controls, 10px horizontal padding, 6px radius, 2px gaps, 14px text, and `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover` on hover. Codex UI's active-tab slider remains the selection indicator.

dsh-caption-bar README · Compact rail：Compact mode is on by default:

```css
--dsh-capbar-compact: 1;
```

| Control | Compact representation |
|---|---|
| Agent preset | existing preset icon; full description remains in `title` |
| Subagent | existing state dot + extracted count + existing chevron |
| Background jobs | existing state dot + extracted count + existing chevron |
| File manager | existing primary button above its existing menu chevron |
| Utilities / right sidebar | unchanged icon controls |

dsh-caption-bar README · Compact rail：The compact rail is **42px** wide with 30px controls (6px on each side). Set this on `body` to restore complete labels and the 104px rail; the layout sweep notices within two seconds:

```css
--dsh-capbar-compact: 0;
```

All compact markers, replacement counts and titles added by this plugin are removed when compact mode is disabled or the plugin is unloaded.
dsh-caption-bar README · Status bubble：The plugin reads semantic DOM projections (`aria-label`, status dots and stable data attributes), not private jobs-store APIs.

dsh-caption-bar README · Visual contract：The plugin is layout-focused. It does not add custom colours, fonts, icons, blur, opacity, shadows or animations. Its deliberate visual exceptions are narrowly tested:
dsh-caption-bar README · Compatibility notes：Hosts without Codex UI receive a minimal one-column fallback.

dsh-caption-bar README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-caption-bar
```

Restart the desktop app once after first installation. Uninstall:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-caption-bar
```

dsh-caption-bar README · Develop：```powershell
pnpm install
node build.mjs
node test/client.smoke.mjs  # 118 assertions
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit

`src/client/index.tsx` contains the stylesheet, applier, title fallback, fullscreen button, compact-mode projection and status bubble. `lib/` is committed because the host serves it directly.

The build refuses to run if a backtick appears inside the `SHEET` template literal, which turns an otherwise distant SWC syntax error into a precise message.
dsh-caption-bar README · Develop：Diagnostics are compiled but silent by default; set `DEBUG = true` in the client source while investigating layout state.
dsh-caption-bar README · Lifecycle：The smoke suite drives the real disposer and asserts this contract.

dsh-caption-bar README · Tuning：| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `--dsh-capbar-compact` | `1` | `1`: compact 42px rail; `0`: full-label 104px rail |
| `--dsh-capbar-compact-box` | `30px` | compact control target |
| `--dsh-capbar-rail` | `104px` | full-label width; compact mode overrides it to 42px |
| `--dsh-capbar-rail-gap` | `6px` | vertical gap between rail items |
| `--dsh-capbar-button` | `28px` | fullscreen button box |
| `--dsh-capbar-gap` | `10px` | gap before native caption buttons |
| `--dsh-capbar-controls` | measured / 138px floor | native caption-button reservation; 0 in fullscreen |
| `--dsh-capbar-lead` | measured | application menu's right edge plus band gap |
| `--dsh-capbar-title-*` | measured | title bounds, width cap and visibility |

dsh-caption-bar README · Troubleshooting history：The detailed five-part incident records live in the workspace's `dev-troubleshooting.md` (faults 27–36). They cover the tab overflow feedback loop, title visibility, app-region hit testing, containing-block drift, disposer loss, conditional title markup, rail redesign, active-slider containing block, dynamic status width, compact cascade order and menu-surface isolation.
dsh-caption-bar 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面布局插件：把会话视图标签放到 Windows 标题栏，并将会话头部工具收纳到右侧窄栏。它还会在标题栏居中显示当前会话标题，提供全屏切换按钮，并用短暂提示气泡展示后台任务和子 agent 状态变化。这样可以为对话内容腾出更多纵向空间。

dsh-caption-bar is a DSH web layout plugin. It moves conversation tabs to the Windows caption row, stacks header utilities in a narrow right rail, centers the session title, adds fullscreen control, and shows brief background job and subagent status bubbles.
想把 DSH 的会话视图标签放到 Windows 标题栏。
DSH 桌面界面的工具能不能收进右侧窄栏？
I want more vertical room for the conversation by moving its tabs into the Windows caption row.
dsh-caption-bar 的功能「标题栏标签与右侧工具栏」：在支持 Windows 标题栏的桌面布局中将会话视图标签排到标题栏，并把会话头部工具纵向堆叠到右侧栏。
dsh-caption-bar 的功能「全屏与状态提示」：在会话头部工具位提供全屏切换，并以短暂气泡显示后台任务或子 agent 的状态变化；点击气泡可打开对应原控件。
